data.name: Mahiraah
data.gender_notes: Mahiraah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is illuminated by the moonlight. The name Mahiraah carries the meaning “Moonlight” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Mahiraah usually hope their child will grow to embody moonlight and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Guiding light in the darkness, serenity, and peace
data.etymology: Mahiraah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moonlight.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mahiraah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: مہیراہ
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مہیراہ تعبیر شدہ مہربان اور شفقت والی شخصیت
in_arabic.long_meaning: مہیراہ ایک عربی نام ہے جو مہر اور شفقت کے معنی رکھتا ہے ۔ یہ نام مہربانی اور خوبی کی علامت ہے ۔ اسلامی تقالید میں اس نام کی اہمیت اس کے معنی کی وجہ سے ہے جو پیار اور مہربانی کی طرف اشارہ کرتے ہیں

in_urdu.name: مہیراہ
in_urdu.meaning: مہیراہ کا مطلب ہے مہربان اور شفقت والی
in_urdu.long_meaning: مہیراہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے مہربانی اور شفقت ۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلم معاشرے میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے کیونکہ یہ پیار اور مہربانی کی نمائندگی کرتا ہے ۔ اس نام کا استعمال تاریخی طور پر اسلامی تقالید میں ہوا ہے

in_hindi.name: महीराह
in_hindi.meaning: महीराह का अर्थ है दयालु और सहानुभूतिपूर्ण
in_hindi.long_meaning: महीराह एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है दयालुता और सहानुभूति । यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में महत्वपूर्ण है क्योंकि यह प्यार और दयालुता का प्रतीक है । इस नाम का उपयोग पारंपरिक रूप से इस्लामी परंपरा में किया गया है

in_pashto.name: مهيراه
in_pashto.meaning: مهيراه د مهربانۍ او شفقت نوم
in_pashto.long_meaning: مهيراه د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی نوم دی چې د مهربانۍ او شفقت معنی لري . دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو کې مهم دی ځکه چې دا د مینې او مهربانۍ استازیتوب کوي . دا نوم په تاريخي توګه د اسلامي دودیزو کې کارول شوی دی

data.cultural_impact: The name Mahiraah holds a significant cultural importance in Islamic society, evoking images of the tranquil and beautiful night sky adorned with the crescent moon. This name represents the ideals of serenity, peace, and the beauty of nature, which are deeply cherished in the Islamic culture.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Mahiraah symbolizes the individual's connection to the divine and the Universe. It serves as a reminder of the importance of seeking knowledge and wisdom, just as the moon reflects the light of the sun. The name Mahiraah also signifies the journey towards enlightenment and the illumination of the soul through the devotion to Allah, as one's life is illuminated by the guidance from the divine.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Moonlight" symbolizes The one who is illuminated by the moonlight. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Mahiraah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of moonlight.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Hisham's Sirah Al-Nabawiyyah The name Mahiraah carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Mentioned as one of the wives of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) who was given the title 'Mother of the Poor' due to her generosity.
